summary: Targeted DARK-MODE visual/readability audit across 9 routes on the preview URL as the demo owner. Almost every page renders correctly in dark mode. Found ONE real dark-mode readability bug on /brief (CEO Brief): the brand-blue accent (VIEW DETAILS links and the 'employees absent' large count) has ~1.67:1 contrast on the dark card — effectively invisible. All other pages, chips (MEDIUM/HIGH/OWNER/FINANCE/etc.), the Decision Desk mic button, the yellow 'Send Daily Digest' button, tab active states, and inputs render with acceptable contrast. Light-mode toggle round-trip works.

ui_bugs.component: CEOBrief.js VIEW DETAILS accent link (6 stat cards)
ui_bugs.issue: `text-brand-blue` renders as rgb(0,47,167) on the dark card bg rgb(22,23,28) — measured contrast 1.67:1 (WCAG minimum 4.5:1). Text is functionally invisible in dark mode. Repro: /brief with html.dark, scan `.text-brand-blue` — 6 hits, all fail. Root cause: `index.css` has no `.dark .text-brand-blue` remap; the existing overrides flip text-black/text-brand-ink/status colours but leave `text-brand-blue` alone.
ui_bugs.selector: .text-brand-blue (data-testid brief-row-delayed / brief-row-completed / brief-row-awaiting_approval / brief-row-absent / brief-row-complaints / brief-row-payment_overdue)

ui_bugs.issue: The absent-tile accent number uses the same `text-brand-blue` (CEOBrief.js line 23 accent) and is very dim/hard to read on the dark card. Same root cause as above.
ui_bugs.selector: div in row where key='absent' – large number rendered with `text-brand-blue`

action_items: Add a `.dark .text-brand-blue` override in /app/frontend/src/index.css (@layer utilities dark block) — e.g. `.dark .text-brand-blue { color: #6ea8ff; }` (or use the already-brightened accent 223 90% 62% ≈ #4d8dfa). This alone will fix the CEO Brief VIEW DETAILS links and the absent-count readability with a single line.
critical_code_review_comments: index.css dark overrides remap text-black / text-brand-ink / text-muted-foreground and green-600 / amber-600 / orange-600, but NOT text-brand-blue. Given `--accent` is already brightened in the dark scale (223 90% 62%), the utility class text-brand-blue should also be lifted for consistency.

STATUS_STYLES in common.js has entries like `owner: bg-brand-red text-white` but /my-work still renders one chip with class list `text-white bg-white` for 'OWNER' — investigate whether that badge bypasses the Chip component or has a duplicate class conflict; in dark mode it happens to render OK (white on dark charcoal) but in light mode this pair would collapse to invisible.

Contrast scan noted `bg-black/10 text-black` chips (`low` priority, `blocked`, `cancelled`, `observation` in common.js STATUS_STYLES) — in dark mode these become rgba(255,255,255,0.10) surface with text flipped to #f4f4f5. On the effective composite bg (~#2f3035) contrast is only borderline (~2.5:1). Not shown in current seeded data on /my-work, but worth strengthening for future tasks with those statuses.

rca of the issue: Root cause of the /brief invisible VIEW DETAILS: index.css @layer utilities has no dark-mode override for the Tailwind `text-brand-blue` class. brand-blue is defined as HSL 223 100% 33% (#002FA7) which is intentionally dark for light-mode contrast; on a #16171c/#1c1d23 dark card it lands at 1.67:1 contrast. Fix: append one line `.dark .text-brand-blue { color: #4d8dfa; }` (or similar HSL 223 90% 62% matching --accent). Reproduction steps: 1) login as demo owner, 2) toggle to dark, 3) navigate to /brief, 4) inspect any `[data-testid^='brief-row-']` — the 'VIEW DETAILS ›' span computed color is rgb(0,47,167); the card bg is rgb(22,23,28). Mitigation is trivial and localized to index.css.
